IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.XmlToSqlSmokeTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE dbo.XmlToSqlSmokeTbl;

CREATE TABLE dbo.XmlToSqlSmokeTbl ( SmokeID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, Note NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, CreatedAt DATE NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_XmlToSqlSmoke_CreatedAt DEFAULT (CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) );
INSERT INTO dbo.XmlToSqlSmokeTbl (Note) VALUES (N'XMLtoSQL smoke row A'), (N'XMLtoSQL smoke row B'), (N'XMLtoSQL smoke row C');
DELETE FROM dbo.XmlToSqlSmokeTbl WHERE Note = N'XMLtoSQL smoke row B';
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.XmlToSqlSmokeTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE dbo.XmlToSqlSmokeTbl;
SELECT CASE WHEN OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.XmlToSqlSmokeTbl', N'U') IS NULL THEN N'XmlToSqlSmokeTbl removed (OK)' ELSE N'XmlToSqlSmokeTbl still exists (FAIL)' END AS CleanupStatus;
